spans.s: Bhiru, n. of a minister of Rudrāyaṇa (bracketed with Hiru): Divy 〔545.5〕.

bhīru (nt.? = Pali id.; in Skt. only adj.), fear: ṣaṣṭhī (sc. Mārasya senā) bhīru pravuccati (so Senart, mss. pranandita, (u)panandati) Mv 〔ii.240.5〕 (vs); in parallel LV 〔262.16〕 bhayaṃ (v.l. bhaya) ṣaṣṭhī nirucyate.
Bhirukaccha, nt., another name for prec. (2): Divy 〔576.25〕.
